scripts.dev:deploy:commit:
echo "$(date +%j).$(git rev-parse --short HEAD):
 branch: from $(git branch --show-current) 
 type: COMMIT
 action: deploy commit to own branch
 date: $(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M:%S) " >> VERSIONS.yaml && surge ./dist --domain https://$(git rev-parse --short HEAD).collisions-docs.surge.sh
scripts.dev:deploy:branch:
echo "$(date +%j).$(git branch --show-current).$(git rev-parse --short HEAD): 
 type: BRANCH
 action: deploy to branch $(git branch --show-current) 
 date: $(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M:%S)" >> VERSIONS.yaml && surge ./dist --domain https://$(git branch --show-current).collisions-docs.surge.sh
